fact: The Gambia's national report to the UPR states that initiatives to increase birth registration were strengthened by implementing electronic civil registration systems in 2022, and that the CRVS Bill 2024 has been validated and awaits Cabinet approval.
title: National report submitted in accordance with paragraph 5 of the annex to Human Rights Council resolution 5/1 (The Gambia)
publisher: United Nations Human Rights Council, Working Group on the Universal Periodic Review
